verdict.rationale: dLocal's docs describe a developer onboarding path: sandbox credentials, a 'make a test payment' guide that can simulate outcomes and trigger webhooks, card, Pix and wallet payment guides, Checkout Redirect, and signed notifications. That supports building a working flow from the docs. However, nothing shows first-party copy-paste code samples or SDKs in multiple languages, and no evidence backs the under-a-day timeline. The docs only link out to ChatGPT/Claude to generate code. missing for 10: first-party copy-paste code examples in multiple languages, official SDKs, evidence of time-to-first-payment under a day, and independent or hands-on corroboration of integration speed.
